meta.title: Caipora — Brazilian Folk Horror Roguelike
meta.description: The forest guardian woke up. Timing-based combat, procedural roguelike, and Brazilian folk horror. Play in the browser.
hero.subtitle: The forest's guardian woke the hell up, and the woods are collecting debts in blood. A folk-horror roguelike that runs right in your browser — no download.
clip.combat.caption: Real gameplay — timing-based combat, captured straight from the game.
clip.boss.short: Face to face with the bosses
climax.title: Every hunt ends in blood
climax.lead: The two moments that seal the forest's fate — captured straight from the game.
climax.finish.title: The claw that crushes the heart
climax.finish.body: On the last hit, time splits open. The Caipora's black claw drives through the invader's chest, seizes the heart and squeezes until it drains — in slow motion, frame by frame. The forest collects with her own hands.
climax.choice.title: Spare — or tear it out
climax.choice.body: The catechist falls beneath the stained glass of his own church. He's still breathing. The whole forest waits for your answer: the mercy that costs the Caipora her life, or the end that lets the woods keep breathing. The choice is yours alone.
access.title: A roguelike that runs in your browser
access.lead: No store, no download, no waiting. Open the link and the woods are already waiting for you — on your phone, tablet or computer.
access.b1.title: Any browser
access.b1.body: Chrome, Safari, Firefox. If it opens a page, it runs Caipora.
access.b2.title: Mobile and desktop
access.b2.body: Touch controls on mobile, keyboard on PC. Portrait or landscape.
access.b3.title: No install
access.b3.body: Zero download, no mandatory account. One click and you're in.
manifesto.title: What was sleeping in the woods wasn't sleeping alone.
manifesto.body: Between twisted trails, dark rivers and abandoned chapels, the ancient pacts between humans, beasts, the dead and the enchanted all snapped. Hunters, priests, witches and corrupted creatures now patrol what was once sacred. Caipora woke up. And she didn't come to save anyone.
bosses.title: The bosses of the woods
bosses.lead: Five broken pacts. Five nightmares that don't know mercy.
boss.mula.desc: Cursed black mare. Her neck ends in a raw stump where a column of fire shoots up for a head. Iron horseshoes gleam with every step — and the harness is still dripping from her last ride.
boss.boitata.desc: The fire snake that drifts through the burnt fields. Its trail don't shine — it burns. Every coil leaves a path of ash, and anyone who looks straight into the light ain't seeing nothing ever again.
boss.curupira.desc: Caipora's kin. Older guardian of the woods, cold and lethal. Feet turned backwards leave tracks going the wrong way — and when he crouches down, the coldness breaks.
boss.saci.desc: Kid made of soot, embers and whirlwinds. The red cap cuts through the air like a blade. The pipe spits filthy smoke. Don't let the size fool you — he's the smallest boss and the fastest one.
boss.jesuita.desc: The final invader. Blessed bayonets in each fist, gold cross on his chest, prayer papers marked in blood. He "converted" the whole forest once. Now it's Caipora's turn.
invaders.title: The invaders
invaders.body: Hunters, witches and corrupted creatures prowl the woods. Humans who broke the pacts and paid with their own humanity. Under the hat, just red slits. Under the hood, just dying embers.
mechanics.title: Timing is everything.
mechanics.body: Hit Space at the exact frame. Land the critical. Perfect dodge and counter. Every miss costs blood. Every hit is a shot at surviving the woods.
gallery.title: Fragments of the forest
cta.title: The forest ain't waiting.
cta.body: Play in the browser. No install. No mercy.
